epics.name: Forecasting and budget planning
epics.objective: Forecast 52 weeks of new cases by state and sex; show budgets only with a sourced cost.

stories.goal: 222 weekly diabetes series ready for forecasting (111 per type: state, region and national by men, women and total)
stories.evidence: 222 SINAVE series read from data/sinave/ from 2022 onward; missing observations interpolated and counted.

stories.goal: a 52-week forecast and exploratory bands, comparing seasonal naive and ETS through rolling-origin selection
stories.evidence: Fresh complete forecast/nested evaluation reproduces all 222 series and metadata after canonical ordering; published values unchanged. 148 ETS, 74 seasonal naive. T2 national/all outer h12–63 SMAPE 9.11%, distinct from model-selection 6.93%. Exploratory nominal-80% coverage is only about 63–65% across levels. Current data have zero gaps; audit guard rejects incomplete/non-finite calendars before any global interpolation. docs/BLIND_AUDIT_20261017.md.

stories.goal: a regional fallback for sparse series and coherent state/region/national totals, after MVP delivery
stories.benefit: retain a forecast for every state
stories.evidence: Regional fallback below five cases in 52 weeks; no series required it. Proportional national/region/state coherence tested in tests/test_forecast.py.

stories.goal: expected cases converted into a budget using an editable, sourced unit cost
stories.benefit: explore resource scenarios by state and sex
stories.evidence: Interactive budget accepts a user-entered cost/source, but unit_cost_mxn and source_cost remain null in the delivered artifact. No project cost source has been established. Audit fixes add quarterly base costs, reject overflow and label the source as user-supplied. Demonstration assumptions do not close this story. docs/BLIND_AUDIT_20261017.md.

stories.goal: a dashboard with state/sex/type filters and observed-versus-forecast curves, after the H18 demo and before H20

Public forecast JSON is byte-identical to repo. Audit fixes verified locally: quarterly costs, overflow rejection, loading error, rounding notice and 390px layout. Original map/combined-type/SARIMA/Prophet/LinuxONE E5 extras remain unimplemented. docs/BLIND_AUDIT_20261017.md.
